newsitem.title: USA: InterDigital names Qualcomm VP as its CEO.
newsitem.headline: InterDigital names Qualcomm VP as its CEO.

text.p: InterDigital Communications Corp said on Monday it named Gregory Webb, formerly a corporate vice president of Qualcomm Inc, as chief executive officer.
The company said Harry Campagna would remain chairman and William Doyle would remain president of InterDigital.
The CEO position had been vacant, InterDigital said.
Webb would work to strengthen InterDigital's strategic relationships with telecommunications companies and focus on product development, the company said.
He had been responsible for marketing, sales and strategic business relationships at Qualcomm.
